findings.title: Table widget feature flag renders an empty table instead of the query results
findings.body: When the organization has the use-table-widget-visualization feature, tableResultComponent renders TableWidgetVisualization with columns={[]} and a hard-coded tableData containing data: [] and empty meta fields/units. It discards result.data, result.meta, fields, field aliases, custom renderers, loading state, and titles from the actual widget query. Enabling the flag therefore makes every dashboard table widget appear empty rather than showing its queried data.

findings.title: Error events and replay segment events are compared using different timestamp units
findings.body: fetch_error_details stores ErrorEvent.timestamp from the nodestore event timestamp, which is seconds since the epoch, while replay recording segment events use rrweb millisecond epoch timestamps. gen_request_data sorts and interleaves them with a direct '<' comparison at line 154, so an error timestamp around 1.7e9 is always considered earlier than segment timestamps around 1.7e12. All errors are consequently emitted before the first breadcrumb instead of in chronological order, and the log text also mixes second-based error times with millisecond-based breadcrumb times for Seer. Normalize one side (for example multiply the error timestamp by 1000) before sorting, merging, and formatting.

findings.title: HIDDEN_ATTRIBUTES are only hidden while a search query is active
findings.body: sortedAndFilteredAttributes returns the full sorted attribute list unchanged when searchQuery is empty; the HIDDEN_ATTRIBUTES exclusion for is_segment, project_id, and received is only applied inside the search-filter branch. As a result these internal attributes are still shown in the default span Attributes view and only disappear after the user starts typing a search, which defeats the purpose of the hidden list. Apply the hidden-attribute filter before/independently of the text search filter.

findings.title: Browser reports with neither age nor timestamp pass validation
findings.body: BrowserReportSerializer marks both age and timestamp required=False and only adds field-level validators that reject the fields when both are present. A report containing neither field therefore passes validation even though the Working Draft format requires age and the Editor's Draft format requires timestamp. The endpoint accepts and counts spec-invalid reports. Add object-level validation requiring exactly one of age or timestamp (also note the current get() checks treat a present value of 0 as absent).

findings.title: Truncated issue titles exceed ISSUE_TITLE_MAX_LENGTH
findings.body: _truncate_title is governed by ISSUE_TITLE_MAX_LENGTH = 50, but for an over-long title it returns title[:50].rstrip() + '...', producing up to 53 characters. The rendered PR/MR comment therefore violates the stated 50-character title limit. Truncate to max_length - len('...') before appending the ellipsis if the constant is meant to bound the final title length.
